content: A husband sought the division of the marital home during a pending separation. The wife, a professional who operated her office in the building, requested the entire property be assigned to her at a depreciated value due to her right of habitation. The Court found that while a physical split was technically possible, it was not "conveniently divisible" due to high structural costs and loss of value. Applying Sezioni Unite 18641/2022, the Court ruled that assigning the property to the habitation-right holder triggers an automatic extinction of that right; therefore, the settlement (conguaglio) must be based on the full market value.
